comment_text.value:
We also have a little community fork of Warp: https://github.com/AndrewWayne/oh-my-warp/tree/main

Nothing too serious — just for hobbyists. The idea is simple: a clean, fast terminal that is remotely accessible over Tailscale.

But oh-my-warp has destroyed me.

Now I’m literally talking to my phone through Typeless and vibe coding from wherever I happen to be.
